items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: So, I get home and there's a letter from Paul. I wonder if they had a job out here. So, I wired him. Come on out.

ctx.x: That's quick, huh? Some of these guys get lonesome. Couldn't, couldn't take it. They're homesick and they can't take it.

So, when, when, when that was, oh, that was, that was before. Paul came on. Uh, they wanted a drummer at the, at the Chinese. And, uh, a versatile drummer because they had put a bottle of show on him, is it? Yeah. And, everybody around town tried for it and couldn't make it. So, I, I heard about the job. And, so, a fellow asked me, he said, do you know any drum? I said, I know it, kid. You could cut that. What do you mean? I don't know, kid, you, the overture was Rhapsody in Blue, you see? Yeah. So, and, and…
